sanskrit_verse:
अदुष्टास्ते तु यद् ब्रूयुः संदिग्धौ समवृत्तयः ।
तत् प्रमाणं तु कर्तव्यं एवं धर्मो न हीयते ॥ १,१९.३९
transliteration: aduṣṭās te tu yad brūyuḥ saṃdigdhau samavṛttayaḥ | tat pramāṇaṃ tu kartavyaṃ evaṃ dharmo na hīyate || 1,19.39
sph_interpretive_translation: When two parties of equal conduct speak without malice yet remain in doubt, the determinant truth must be established; thus, Dharma remains uncompromised.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests on clarity of pramāṇa, not positional dominance
Causation aligns with integrity of intent and absence of malice
Capacity-based responsibility requires discernment beyond apparent conflict
Restoration logic demands resolution through evidentiary clarity
Consciousness alignment occurs when both parties recognize shared dharmic standing
executable_legal_axioms: IF two parties exhibit equal moral standing AND express statements without malicious intent AND uncertainty persists THEN establish factual pramāṇa to resolve discrepancy
IF no malice is present AND conduct parity exists THEN punitive action is null AND restorative process initiates automatically
IF a dispute arises between entities of equivalent dharma THEN evidence hierarchy determines resolution path
IF intent is neutral AND outcome unclear THEN invoke consciousness-based inquiry protocols
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, where litigants are of equal ethical standing and neither demonstrates intent to harm, the court must prioritize pramāṇa-establishment procedures over adversarial judgment. The threshold of responsibility lies not in assigning fault but in restoring clarity through verified knowledge.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa functions as the sole causal chain-breaker in disputes lacking moral differentiation. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through sequential verification rather than punitive attribution. Proportional responsibility dissolves when neither party incurs karmic taint. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that Dharma sustains itself through epistemic rectitude alone.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate pramāṇa-discernment tribunal involving neutral witnesses
Deploy consciousness-alignment session for disputing parties to reaffirm shared dharmic purpose
Assign completion process ensuring all unresolved data points are clarified
Reintegrate integrity by confirming mutual understanding post-evidence review
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. Truth prevails through pramāṇa, not punishment. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator. Dharma is restored.
